# Lexicon

The reserved words, the operator tokens and the precedence table, from
`spec/lexicon.json` (format: `spec/lexicon.md`), which `tools/gen-lexicon.mjs`
checks against `spec/grammar.md` and `spec/SPEC.md` §5 before rendering — the
prose there defines them; this page lists them. Every host's lexer and parser
are built from the same table.

## Reserved words

`TRUE` `FALSE` `NULL` `AND` `OR` `NOT` `XOR` `EQL` `IN` `BAND` `BOR` `BXOR`

Reserved words are case-insensitive, like every identifier, and cannot name a
variable.
